name: Short-circuiting or grounding device
summary: Makes a defined short-circuit or earth connection for the purpose shown in the machine or apparatus scheme.
description: Makes a defined short-circuit or earth connection for the purpose shown in the machine or apparatus scheme.

In a drafting package, connect this reference to the conductors being shorted or earthed. The associated drawing should trace the operating mechanism and interlocks; the number identifies the role and does not specify the terminal arrangement, ratings or operating settings.
readingNotes: Identify the conductors being shorted or earthed.

drawingChecklist: Label the conductors being shorted or earthed.
Cross-reference the operating mechanism and interlocks.
Identify the device tag, manual revision and logic drawing that define this implementation.
distinction: The function number does not establish the making capacity or safe-use procedure of an earthing device.
